cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)

project(berry LANGUAGES C)

set(BERRY_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
set(BERRY_DEF_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/default")

set(BERRY_MAPPING_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../berry_mapping/src")
set(BERRY_INT64_DIR   "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../berry_int64/src")
set(BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../berry_custom/src")
set(BERRY_MATTER_DIR  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../berry_matter/src")
set(RE15_DIR          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../re1.5")

set(SESAME_MATTER_SHIM_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/matter")

set(BERRY_GEN_OUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generate")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${BERRY_GEN_OUT}")

# ----- coc prebuild -----
set(COC_TOOL "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/coc/coc")
# coc reads every -c file and merges all #defines into a single map (last
# write wins). For the native build, append our host overrides after the
# standard config so BE_USE_SOLIDIFY_MODULE etc. end up enabled — without
# editing the on-device config.
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    set(COC_CONF "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/berry_conf.h")
else()
    set(COC_CONF
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/berry_conf.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sesame_solidify/coc_conf.h"
    )
endif()

if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    # The solidified headers now live in the build tree, generated by the
    # berry_matter_solidify{,_extra} targets — point coc at both dirs.
    set(BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_OUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third_party/berry_matter/solidify")
    set(BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_OUT   "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third_party/berry_matter/solidify_extra")
    set(COC_INPUT_DIRS
        "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_MATTER_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_OUT}"
        "${BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_OUT}"
        "${SESAME_MATTER_SHIM_DIR}"
    )
    # Compute the expected solidify outputs from the .be source list so coc
    # re-runs whenever any header is regenerated. (We don't glob the build
    # dir because configure-time globs miss future invalidations.)
    file(GLOB BERRY_MATTER_BE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${BERRY_MATTER_DIR}/embedded/*.be")
    set(BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_HEADERS "")
    foreach(be ${BERRY_MATTER_BE_SOURCES})
        get_filename_component(stem "${be}" NAME_WE)
        if(stem MATCHES "_test$")
            continue()
        endif()
        list(APPEND BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_HEADERS
            "${BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_OUT}/solidified_${stem}.h")
    endforeach()
    file(GLOB BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_BE CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${BERRY_MATTER_DIR}/../berry_matter/extra/*.be")
    set(BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_HEADERS "")
    foreach(be ${BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_BE})
        get_filename_component(stem "${be}" NAME_WE)
        list(APPEND BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_HEADERS
            "${BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_OUT}/solidified_${stem}.h")
    endforeach()
    file(GLOB COC_DEP_FILES
        "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_MATTER_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_MATTER_DIR}/*.h"
        "${SESAME_MATTER_SHIM_DIR}/*.c" "${SESAME_MATTER_SHIM_DIR}/*.h"
    )
    list(APPEND COC_DEP_FILES
        ${BERRY_MATTER_SOLIDIFY_HEADERS} ${BERRY_MATTER_EXTRA_HEADERS})
else()
    # Native build only needs the host interpreter, so coc only scans what
    # berry_host actually compiles. In particular, default/be_re_lib.c needs
    # be_fixed_re.h to be generated.
    set(COC_INPUT_DIRS
        "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}"
    )
    file(GLOB COC_DEP_FILES
        "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/be_re_lib.c"
        "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}/*.h"
        "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}/*.c" "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}/*.h"
    )
endif()

set(COC_STAMP "${BERRY_GEN_OUT}/.coc.stamp")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${COC_STAMP}"
    COMMAND python3 ${COC_TOOL} -o ${BERRY_GEN_OUT} -c ${COC_CONF} -- ${COC_INPUT_DIRS}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${COC_STAMP}
    DEPENDS ${COC_DEP_FILES} ${COC_TOOL} ${COC_CONF}
    COMMENT "Running coc prebuild (Berry const tables)"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(berry_coc DEPENDS "${COC_STAMP}")

# ----- berry library -----
file(GLOB BERRY_SOURCES "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/*.c")
file(GLOB BERRY_MAPPING_SOURCES "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/*.c")
file(GLOB BERRY_INT64_SOURCES   "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}/*.c")
file(GLOB BERRY_CUSTOM_SOURCES  "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}/*.c")

list(REMOVE_ITEM BERRY_MAPPING_SOURCES "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}/be_mapping_security_tests.c")
list(REMOVE_ITEM BERRY_SOURCES "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/be_oslib.c")

set(RE15_SOURCES
    "${RE15_DIR}/compilecode.c"
    "${RE15_DIR}/pike.c"
    "${RE15_DIR}/charclass.c"
)

add_library(berry STATIC
    ${BERRY_SOURCES}
    ${BERRY_MAPPING_SOURCES}
    ${BERRY_INT64_SOURCES}
    ${BERRY_CUSTOM_SOURCES}
    ${RE15_SOURCES}
)

add_dependencies(berry berry_coc)

target_include_directories(berry
    PUBLIC
    "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}"
    "${BERRY_GEN_OUT}"
    "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}"
    "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}"
    "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}"
    "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}"
    "${RE15_DIR}"
)

target_compile_definitions(berry
    PUBLIC
    TASMOTA
    BERRY_MODULE_CONTINUE
    BE_USE_MATH_MODULE=1
    BE_USE_JSON_MODULE=1
)

if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    target_link_libraries(berry PUBLIC globals)
else()
    # ---------- berry_host: standalone Berry interpreter for the host ----------
    # Used by the solidify pipeline to compile .be sources into
    # solidified_*.h headers at build time. Lives outside the cross-compile
    # tree so it can run during the native build (see top-level CMakeLists).
    #
    # The custom files under sesame_solidify/ exist for two reasons:
    #   * default/berry_conf.h disables BE_USE_SOLIDIFY_MODULE and
    #     BE_USE_OS_MODULE — both required by solidify_all.be.
    #   * default/host_modtab.c aliases `tasmota`, `crypto`, `matter`, `_class`
    #     to the `sys` module, which makes `import matter` return a shared,
    #     effectively read-only object. solidify_all.be assigns attributes
    #     onto these modules, so the aliases must be absent.
    set(RE15_SOURCES_HOST
        "${RE15_DIR}/compilecode.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/pike.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/charclass.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/cleanmarks.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/sub.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/util.c"
        "${RE15_DIR}/recursiveloop.c"
    )
    # be_oslib.c is excluded from the cross-compile BERRY_SOURCES list but
    # the host build needs it for `import os` used by solidify_all.be.
    set(BERRY_HOST_SOURCES ${BERRY_SOURCES} "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}/be_oslib.c")
    set(BERRY_HOST_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sesame_solidify")
    add_executable(berry_host
        ${BERRY_HOST_SOURCES}
        ${BERRY_MAPPING_SOURCES}
        ${BERRY_INT64_SOURCES}
        ${BERRY_CUSTOM_SOURCES}
        ${RE15_SOURCES_HOST}
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/berry.c"
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/be_re_lib.c"
        # POSIX filesystem backing for `import os` (host_port.c is the minimal
        # variant that lacks be_dirfirst, be_chdir, etc.).
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}/default/be_port.c"
        "${BERRY_HOST_DIR}/host_modtab.c"
    )
    add_dependencies(berry_host berry_coc)
    target_compile_definitions(berry_host
        PRIVATE
        BERRY_HOST_BUILD
    )
    target_include_directories(berry_host
        PRIVATE
        "${BERRY_HOST_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_SRC_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_GEN_OUT}"
        "${BERRY_DEF_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_MAPPING_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_INT64_DIR}"
        "${BERRY_CUSTOM_DIR}"
        "${RE15_DIR}"
    )
    target_link_libraries(berry_host PRIVATE m)
endif()
